note: Where the code reaches other code through a table, a registry, getattr with a computed name, a callback or duck typing, so the call cannot be followed as an ordinary call edge in the counterparts. 'dynamic_calls' are the sites the syntax-tree helper detected (a call on a subscript such as X[k](...) and getattr with a computed name). The helper cannot see every site: a method called on a variable whose type is unknown is an 'unresolved_call' in the counterpart of the file, and the protocols below say which classes can be behind such variables.

dynamic_calls.explanation: leerlijn_tabel, denkfouten, spiekbrief or the argumenten lambda, chosen by the auto block kind.

dynamic_calls.leads_to: a dict of lambdas defined inside the function
dynamic_calls.explanation: One formula per kind (rechthoek_opp, rechthoek_omtrek, vierkant_*, driehoek_opp, parallellogram_opp, trapezium_opp, cirkel_*, balk_volume, kubus_volume); the lambdas are local and not separate functions in the map.
getattr(self, '_' + soort) picks the generator of the chosen kind of solution (alles_juist, rekenfout, denkfout) from the leerlijn's 'fouten' list.

One of: App.herhaalvragen; a function that resumes the last exercise (built by _vorige_voorstel); App.herhalen_of_verder (asks 'eerst herhalen?' when the last exercise was finished and repeat questions are due); or navigatie.vak(app, first subject).

dynamic_calls.leads_to: the callbacks in the local list `keuzes` of the main menu
dynamic_calls.explanation: App.herhalen, navigatie.vak(self, vak, [HOOFD]) for each subject, navigatie.spiekbrieven (Leerstof), App.mijn_avatar, App.winkel, App.zeg_het_ons, or None (Stoppen).

The callbacks built in terminal/curriculum/modi.py (oefenaar, eenheden, snel, spiek_oefenaar ...) for the modes reeks, vrij, 60s, 20sommen, tabel; they open the Oefenaar, MatenOefenaar or Snelrekenen screens.
The input-object class for the question's answer type; here only classes with eigen_scherm = True (terminal/tabel.py: EenheidInvoer, TabelInvoer) are used.

Any input-object class: RoosterInvoer, StaartInvoer, BalkInvoer, VeldInvoer, CoordInvoer, KlokInvoer, VraagstukInvoer, SpeurInvoer, KeuzeInvoer, ZinsdelenInvoer, WerkwoordInvoer. Its methods (hoogte, knoppen, teken, toets, hulp, rijen ...) are then called through duck typing and show up as unresolved calls.
Every input-object class; the test draws each one on a recording screen.

protocols.name: Input object
protocols.contract: Attributes and methods the Oefenaar calls without knowing the class: v, o, hoogte(nagekeken), knoppen(), teken(s, y, uitslag, hulp), toets(k) -> None or (typed answer, number), hulp(o), rijen(), melding, melding_rol, fouten, diagnose, cursor_pos, hint; optional eigen_tekst, eigen_tip, eigen_scherm, geen_tweede_kans, vraag_is_zin, tips_op, spiekbrief_bekeken, naast, extra, uitleg_na, plaatswaarden, tweede_kans, spiekbrief_aan.
protocols.consequence: Calls like obj.toets(k) in Oefenaar._stel_vraag are listed as unresolved_calls with up to six candidates; the Oefenaar and the beta Oefenaar read optional attributes with getattr(obj, 'name', default).

protocols.name: Topic (Onderwerp)
protocols.contract: Subclasses of Onderwerp implement maak_met, nakijken, diagnose, uitleg, tip, spiekbrief, klad_voor, lees_vraag, herhaal_data, maak_herhaling, onderwerp_van_sleutel and more; the screens, reports and repeat bin call them on whichever topic object they got.
implementers: kern/wiskunde/*.py and kern/taal/*.py topic classes (see ONDERWERPEN)
protocols.consequence: Calls such as o.maak(...), o.nakijken(...), o.diagnose(...) on a variable `o` are unresolved_calls with many candidates (listed only when there are six or fewer).

protocols.name: Structure (Structuur)
protocols.contract: The 20 Structuur subclasses each build the numbers and steps of one kind of word problem; stel_samen looks them up by id.
protocols.consequence: A structure id from the learning line or from stored repeat data chooses the class at run time.

protocols.name: Curriculum mode callbacks
protocols.contract: Each mode of a topic is a callable (app, breadcrumb) that opens a screen.
implementers: terminal/curriculum/modi.py: oefenaar, eenheden, snel, spiek_oefenaar, spiek_eenheden
protocols.consequence: navigatie.start calls modi[modus](app, kr): see the dynamic call list.

protocols.name: Cheat sheet objects
protocols.contract: A topic's `spiek` object has a toon(app, kr) method that opens the right cheat sheet.
protocols.consequence: onderwerp.spiek.toon(...) in navigatie.start is an unresolved call.

protocols.name: Fake screens and windows in tests
protocols.contract: NepScherm and NepKlokvenster replace curses and the clock window with the same methods.
protocols.consequence: Code under test calls the same method names on the fake and on the real object.
